item.description:
Alternative title: Carcinization? In my C++ codebase? It’s more likely than you think.

Whilst the job search continues, I thought I’d get out a quicker writeup about a lifesaver of a tool I’ve recently implemented in my ongoing project indy-tui1 and how I stumbled iterated my way to it.

item.title: Delayable Telemetry Queue | Design Notes - indy-tui
item.description: As the core impetus for my most recent (and ongoing) project, I think a break down of my design and implementation of the delay queue used in #indy-tui is perfectly befitting of a first post.
